data.revised_prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality desktop SaaS admin UI redesign for a Chinese private-domain community management system, 1440x1024 landscape. Use the attached current product screenshot as the primary visual source and preserve its existing brand language: white and very light gray surfaces, black text and controls, vivid acid-lime #CCFF00 accents, compact monochrome iconography, restrained 6–8px radii, quiet utilitarian operations-tool character, left navigation and top utility bar.

Concept 3: Master-detail community management workspace. Active page title: 微信群管理. Keep the existing sidebar structure and overall brand feel. Redesign the main content into a clean two-pane operational layout: LEFT pane is a searchable, filterable list/table of WeChat groups with compact rows, group name, region, type, owner, capacity progress bar, status badges, and action buttons. RIGHT pane is a detailed master-detail panel for the selected group, showing summary cards, member stats, join/leave trends, recent activity timeline, tags, owner info, and management actions. The selected row should be visibly highlighted. Include small tabs or segmented filters for group categories. Add top-right page actions such as 新建微信群 and view toggles. Keep typography crisp and dense, with strong alignment, subtle dividers, soft shadows, and high information density.

UI details: Chinese labels, realistic production dashboard quality, enterprise admin aesthetic, compact table rows, subtle zebra or hover states, lime accents only for primary actions and status highlights, no playful illustrations, no dark mode, no glassmorphism. Ensure polished spacing and balanced composition, with the left sidebar remaining visible and the master-detail panel occupying the remaining space in a two-column layout.
